facilities.name: Kalyana Katta (Tonsure)
facilities.description: Dedicated tonsure complexes are operated near the Godavari River ghats.

facilities.name: RO Drinking Water
facilities.description: Purified reverse osmosis (RO) drinking water plants are installed across the queue lines and waiting halls.

facilities.name: Luggage Deposit & Footwear Counters
facilities.description: Located near the temple entrance gates.

facilities.name: Automated Security Lockers & Cloakrooms
facilities.description: Available near the entrance gates for depositing prohibited electronic items (mobile phones, cameras, laptops, smartwatches).

facilities.name: Accessibility (Lift & Wheelchairs)
facilities.description: A lift is available near a side entrance for elderly and differently-abled devotees. Wheelchairs are available and can be requested at the main temple entrance.

facilities.name: Nithya Annadanam Complex
facilities.description: The temple operates a Nithya Annadanam complex near the main entrance serving free pure vegetarian lunch daily from 11:30 AM to 2:30 PM.

facilities.name: Dedicated Parking Areas
facilities.description: Dedicated open parking spaces are maintained by the temple administration near the temple entrance and town bus stand.

facilities.name: Public Toilets
facilities.description: Located near the main temple entry gates, Kalyana Katta, and the town bus stand.

facilities.name: First Aid Center
facilities.description: A basic first-aid room is maintained by the Devasthanam near the main temple administrative block during darshan hours.

facilities.name: Barricaded Queue Compartments
facilities.description: Steel queue corridors and holding compartments with drinking water and seating.

facilities.name: Local Shuttles
facilities.description: Shared and private auto-rickshaws connecting the bus stand and local choultries directly to the temple gates.
